mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket(user_id, draw_no, numbers, bet_count, amount, status, buy_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{userId}, #{drawNo}, #{numbers}, #{betCount}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{buyTime}, #{buyTime}, #{buyTime})

INSERT INTO ticket(user_id, draw_no, numbers, bet_count, amount, status, buy_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{t.userId}, #{t.drawNo}, #{t.numbers}, #{t.betCount}, #{t.amount}, #{t.status}, #{t.buyTime}, #{t.buyTime}, #{t.buyTime})
mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS ticketId, t.draw_no AS drawNo, t.numbers, t.bet_count AS betCount, t.amount, t.status, t.buy_time AS buyTime, u.username, u.phone FROM ticket t LEFT JOIN user u ON t.user_id = u.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY t.buy_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT t.user_id AS userId, u.username, t.bet_count AS betCount, CASE WHEN t.status = 2 THEN '特等奖' WHEN t.status = 3 THEN '一等奖' END AS prizeLevel, CASE WHEN t.status = 2 THEN 5000000 WHEN t.status = 3 THEN 100000 END AS prizeAmount FROM ticket t JOIN user u ON t.user_id = u.id WHERE t.draw_no = #{drawNo} AND t.status IN (2, 3) ORDER BY t.status ASC, u.username ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket WHERE draw_no = #{drawNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket WHERE draw_no = #{drawNo} AND status = 2
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket WHERE draw_no = #{drawNo} AND status = 3
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket WHERE draw_no = #{drawNo} AND status = 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM ticket WHERE draw_no = #{drawNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
